text: After I use the sink, water collects inside the cabinet below it.
The toilet bowl fills almost to the top every time I flush.
Water is seeping out where two pipes are joined behind the fridge.
The shower has become only a weak trickle even though other taps are fine.
A puddle keeps forming around the base of the commode.
The kitchen sink takes several minutes to empty.
I can hear water running inside the wall even when all taps are closed.
The tap handle turns but no water comes out.
Dirty water comes back up through the bathroom drain.
The pipe connected to the washing machine drips during a wash.
The overhead tank keeps losing water even when nobody is using it.
There is moisture and a wet patch below the upstairs washroom.
The toilet keeps refilling every few minutes by itself.
The kitchen faucet has become very hard to close completely.
Water sprays from the hose connection near the garden tap.
The sink gives off a sewage smell whenever water drains.
The bathroom floor stays flooded because the drain is not clearing.
Hot water is dripping near the heater pipe connection.
The main water shutoff turns but does not stop the flow.
There is a gurgling sound from the sink and the water drains slowly.
Only half of the power outlets in my room are working.
The ceiling fan hums but the blades do not start moving.
A wall outlet becomes hot after I plug in the rice cooker.
The lights dim whenever the refrigerator starts.
My breaker trips as soon as I switch on the water heater.
There is a crackling noise coming from the switchboard.
The porch lamp stays on even during daytime.
I saw a small flash when I inserted a plug into the socket.
The fan regulator changes nothing and the fan stays at one speed.
One light circuit stopped working while the rest of the house still has power.
The plug feels loose and falls out of the wall outlet.
The doorbell works only sometimes and then stops.
The fuse burns out whenever I use two appliances together.
There is a smell of burnt plastic near the main electrical board.
The bedroom light flickers even after I changed the bulb.
An old cable near the ceiling has damaged insulation.
The outdoor sensor light no longer turns on at night.
The main switch makes a buzzing sound when several appliances are running.
My electric heater has power at the socket but will not switch on.
The power in the room cuts in and out when the switch is touched.
My bedroom door scrapes the floor and is difficult to close.
The wooden wardrobe has a shelf that has bent and fallen down.
One side of the dining table is lower because a leg has become loose.
The cabinet door hangs crooked and does not line up with the frame.
The wooden window frame has softened and started to rot.
A drawer front has come away from the rest of the drawer.
The bed frame squeaks and moves because the wooden joints are loose.
The front door has split around the lock area.
A wooden chair wobbles because one joint has opened up.
The cupboard needs an extra shelf fitted inside.
The timber handrail on the stairs is loose at one end.
Part of the wooden floor lifts slightly when I step on it.
The wooden gate has dropped and now catches on the ground.
The desk surface is cracked near the edge.
The wardrobe sliding door no longer moves smoothly on its track.
The wooden window does not sit square inside its frame.
The backrest of a wooden chair has become detached.
A kitchen cabinet hinge has pulled out of the wood.
The wooden partition panel has a large damaged section.
The veranda bench has split along one of the boards.
The steel gate has separated at one of its welded joints.
A metal balcony rail is cracked where it meets the post.
The iron fence post has broken away from its base plate.
The hinge bracket on my metal gate has snapped off.
A steel chair frame has split near the seat support.
The metal rack in the storeroom has a broken crossbar.
One joint on the iron window grill has come apart.
The steel canopy support is cracked close to the wall bracket.
The metal table frame has broken at the corner.
A section of the security grill is loose because the weld has failed.
The steel staircase handrail has separated from a support post.
The garage gate frame has a crack near the bottom hinge.
A metal bed frame joint has opened and needs to be joined again.
The iron awning bracket is partially detached.
A steel shelf support has snapped at the welded connection.
The garden fence has a metal bar that has broken from the frame.
The metal shutter guide frame is cracked near the corner.
The latch support on the driveway gate has broken loose.
